material_properties.needed: Identify each supplier alloy and temper. Record E, G, nu, density and yield with reviewed provenance and uncertainty. Do not reuse assumed 6061-T6 strength for all parts.

torsion_and_shear_center.needed: Qualify Saint-Venant J, shear-center offsets and applicability for each actual profile. Address eccentric loads, torsion and warping. Polar bending inertia is not a torsion qualification.

connections.needed: Model splice inserts, carriage plates, spacers, wheels and fasteners. Record load transfer, release or stiffness assumptions and capacity evidence. Do not assume composite insert action or universal rigid joints.

supports.needed: Identify actual support attachments and restrained degrees of freedom. Review fixture compliance and reactions.

mass_and_payload.needed: Account for beam self-weight, all nonbeam masses, motors and payload. Declare attachment and eccentricity for each force. Do not derive heterogeneous component mass from a common aluminum density.

travel_loads.needed: Freeze static cases over center, travel endpoints and critical intermediate positions. Include gravity, payload, belt reactions and operating lateral loads with approved provenance.

service_limits.needed: Approve service deflection, displacement measurement location, stress limit and safety factor for the intended task. Historical numbers are controls only.

candidate_extraction.needed: Derive load-bearing stations, eccentric attachments and interfaces from verified candidate solids. Account for all occurrences and solids, including multi-solid sources. Qualify nonbeam load paths.

independent_controls.needed: Review actual-profile reference, incorrect-placement, disconnected-splice, support, weak-axis and overload controls independently. Verify analytical or independent numerical results and preserved failures.

blind_assignment.needed: Qualify automatic authored-part assignment and structural bindings independently of the candidate author. Preserve blind task boundaries.

immutable_isolated_runtime.needed: Stage immutable hash-verified operator inputs and enforce isolated geometry and solver worker time and memory limits before untrusted public submissions.

physical_comparison.needed: Compare predicted displacement and reactions with controlled physical measurements. Qualify connection compliance and capacity before claims about physical readiness or safe load.
